use default
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use RGB = (red: ubyte, green: ubyte, blue: ubyte)

pt(x: double, y: double) -> (x: double, y: double) => (x = x, y = y)

scene() -> IMAGE is
    let image = IMAGE(160, 120)

    for y in 0..80 do
        let t = cast double(y) / 80.0D

        image.colour(
            cast ubyte(40.0D + 200.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(70.0D + 100.0D * t),
            cast ubyte(160.0D - 60.0D * t))
        image.fill_rectangle(
            0.0D, cast double(y), 160.0D, cast double(y + 1))
    od

    image.colour(255ub, 220ub, 60ub)
    image.disc(112.0D, 42.0D, 15.0D)

    image.colour(90ub, 60ub, 120ub)
    image.fill([pt(0.0D, 80.0D), pt(45.0D, 30.0D), pt(95.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(60ub, 110ub, 70ub)
    image.fill([pt(55.0D, 80.0D), pt(105.0D, 48.0D), pt(160.0D, 80.0D)])

    image.colour(70ub, 150ub, 60ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(0.0D, 80.0D, 160.0D, 120.0D)

    image.colour(200ub, 35ub, 40ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(22.0D, 88.0D, 52.0D, 110.0D)

    image.colour(120ub, 25ub, 30ub)
    image.fill([pt(18.0D, 88.0D), pt(37.0D, 75.0D), pt(56.0D, 88.0D)])

    image.colour(250ub, 245ub, 235ub)
    image.fill_rectangle(33.0D, 97.0D, 41.0D, 110.0D)

    image
si

use Layer = (name: string, row: int, column: int, show: RGB -> RGB)

byte(v: double) -> ubyte =>
    cast ubyte(Math.round(255.0D * Math.clamp(v, 0.0D, 1.0D)))

fraction(b: ubyte) -> double => cast double(b) / 255.0D

ink(amount: double, r: double, g: double, b: double) -> RGB =>
    (
        red = byte(1.0D - amount * (1.0D - r)),
        green = byte(1.0D - amount * (1.0D - g)),
        blue = byte(1.0D - amount * (1.0D - b)))

cmyk(p: RGB) -> (c: double, m: double, y: double, k: double) is
    let r = fraction(p.red), g = fraction(p.green), b = fraction(p.blue)
    let k = 1.0D - Math.max(r, Math.max(g, b))

    if k >= 1.0D then
        return (0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D)
    fi

    let rest = 1.0D - k

    ((1.0D - r - k) / rest, (1.0D - g - k) / rest, (1.0D - b - k) / rest, k)
si

let layers: Layer[] = [
    ("original", 0, 0, p => p),
    ("red", 0, 1, p => (red = p.red, green = 0ub, blue = 0ub)),
    ("green", 0, 2, p => (red = 0ub, green = p.green, blue = 0ub)),
    ("blue", 0, 3, p => (red = 0ub, green = 0ub, blue = p.blue)),
    ("cyan", 1, 1, p => ink(1.0D - fraction(p.red), 0.0D, 1.0D, 1.0D)),
    ("magenta", 1, 2, p => ink(1.0D - fraction(p.green), 1.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D)),
    ("yellow", 1, 3, p => ink(1.0D - fraction(p.blue), 1.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D)),
    ("cyan", 2, 0, p => ink(cmyk(p).c, 0.0D, 1.0D, 1.0D)),
    ("magenta", 2, 1, p => ink(cmyk(p).m, 1.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D)),
    ("yellow", 2, 2, p => ink(cmyk(p).y, 1.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D)),
    ("black", 2, 3, p => ink(cmyk(p).k, 0.0D, 0.0D, 0.0D))
]

scene().write("scene.png")

let source = IMAGE.read("scene.png")
let cell_width = source.width + 10
let cell_height = source.height + 24

let sheet = IMAGE(cell_width * 4 + 10, cell_height * 3 + 10)

sheet.clear(235ub, 235ub, 230ub)

for layer in layers do
    let left = 10 + layer.column * cell_width
    let top = 10 + layer.row * cell_height

    for y in 0..source.height do
        for x in 0..source.width do
            let p = layer.show(source.pixel(x, y))

            sheet.set_pixel(left + x, top + y, p.red, p.green, p.blue)
        od
    od

    sheet.colour(40ub, 40ub, 40ub)
    sheet.text(
        cast double(left + source.width / 2),
        cast double(top + source.height + 15),
        10.0D, layer.name, Anchor.CENTRE)
od

let key_top = cast double(10 + cell_height + 40)

for (i, line) in ["top: RGB", "middle: CMY", "bottom: CMYK"] |> index() do
    let y = key_top + 18.0D * cast double(i)

    sheet.text(90.0D, y, 11.0D, line, Anchor.CENTRE)
od

write_line("RGB, CMY and CMYK layers")

sheet.write("separation.png")

sheet.show("separation.png")
